summary: High reel skip rate (64% in first 3s) shows hooks fail; chatbot posts earn 26% of website per reach. Bio violates rules: niche, region, timeframe, free offer. Need stronger hooks, rotate styles, fix bio.
guidance:
- Hook style: rotate to **question** (1.83x) or **top3** (1.5x) for chatbot post; avoid **contrast** (0.36x of top3).
- Avoid repeating "wrong price/timing" and "same questions" angles — used in last 3 chatbot posts.
- Use **silhouette** or **bright-desk** image style (1.5x) for carousel/image; reels underperform (0.21x of image).
- Posts must read as a developer sharing real work, never an ad. No demos, samples, or niche targeting.

instructions.research: Find 2-3 common FAQ patterns across diverse Indian small businesses (e.g., clinic timings, salon pricing, gym membership) to illustrate chatbot value without naming a niche.
instructions.analysis: Compare last 3 chatbot post metrics (reach, skip rate) to identify which hook style (question vs comparison) held attention longer; note the drop-off second.
instructions.writer: Write a question-hook carousel: "What are the 3 questions your customers ask every day?" Show a generic example conversation (labelled "Example") and end with "Pay after approval — DM to discuss fit."
instructions.image: Create a 3-slide carousel using **bright-desk** style: slide 1 hook question, slide 2 labelled example chat bubbles, slide 3 offer + DM CTA. No branding, no demo implication.
instructions.video: Skip reel today; static carousel outperforms reels 5x per reach. If video needed later, script a 3-second hook showing a phone notification sound with "New query" text.

manual_tips: Update Instagram bio to: "AI chatbots, animated ads, lead lists & websites for small businesses across India. Pay after approval. DM for honest advice." Remove niche, region, timeframe, free offer.
Comment thoughtfully on 5 posts from Indian small business owners (cafes, clinics, gyms) about handling customer queries — no self-promo, just genuine engagement.
Reply to any story mentions or tags from collaborators (editorxyz_official, shiven_xyz) to maintain relationship without asking for shares.
